President Bola Tinubu has congratulated the President of the Nasrul-Lahi-L-Fatih Society of Nigeria, Ayodeji Abdulrauf, as he marks his birthday on November 23, 2026. The President described him as a renowned scholar, teacher and administrator of great repute. Tinubu conveyed his congratulations in a statement signed on Sunday by his Special Adviser on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga. The Nigerian leader joined Abdulrauf’s family, associates and NASFAT members worldwide in celebrating a leader he credited with making significant contributions to the propagation of Islam in Nigeria and beyond. The President said, “Under his visionary leadership, NASFAT has helped considerably in fostering religious harmony, promoting community development and supporting the Federal Government’s socioeconomic empowerment initiatives.” Tinubu arrives Lagos after Ibadan APC rally Bayelsa boat tragedy: Tinubu orders low-key Oyo APC rally Tinubu praises Jibrin’s book on economic diversification “I congratulate Alhaji Abdulrauf on his birthday and applaud his contributions to the Muslim community and numerous achievements as NASFAT President.” Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources “I wish him good health, continued grace of Allah and many more years of religious and community impact,” he added. President Tinubu noted Abdulrauf’s commitment to providing religious and spiritual guidance to NASFAT members in Nigeria and across the world. NASFAT, founded in Lagos in 1995, is one of Nigeria’s largest Islamic organisations, with chapters across the country and in the diaspora. The society is known for combining Islamic scholarship with social welfare programmes, including education, healthcare and economic empowerment initiatives, and has grown into a significant voice in Nigeria’s Muslim community.
